title: Internal Hom of a coproduct is a product
statement: For a sheaf of rings R and a family of sheaf modules M indexed by I, any colimit cofan c with point c.pt induces a limit fan whose point is internalHom(c.pt,N) and whose projections are precomposition by c.inj i.

proof.text: Use the tensor-Hom adjunction to identify maps into internal Hom with maps out of a tensor product. Tensoring with a fixed module preserves coproducts because it is a left adjoint, and curry the descended map. Naturality gives the fan factors and the coproduct universal property gives uniqueness.

from.place: tensor-Hom adjunction and coproduct universal property

lean.statement:
theorem internalHomCoproductFanIsLimit {I : Type w} (M : I → Mod)
    (c : Cofan M) (hc : IsColimit c) (N : Mod) :
    Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk (homObj (R := R) c.pt N)
      (fun i ↦ homObjMap (R := R) (c.inj i) (𝟙 N))))
